title: Theoretical and experimental studies on stability, bonding and isolation of elusive bis-(dichloro-aluminium) oxides supported by donor-base ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9208-9215
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00211G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maria Francis, Kishor Shinde, Sudipta Roy
The bonding, and stability of various donor base-supported bis-(dichloro-aluminium) oxides are theoretically predicted along with first solid-state isolation of the cyclic alkyl(amino) carbene (cAAC)-stabilized analogue (cAAC)Al(Cl2)-O-Al(Cl2)(cAAC).
